title: The canonical map from a complex into the internal Hom of its total tensor product
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the canonical comparison map from a complex into the internal Hom of the total tensor product with another complex, functorially in both variables, and the proof is a 37-line argument that refers to the monoidal source of the map and then gives a direct construction. The direct construction introduces double index notation for the target, writes down the differentials with their signs, defines the map by sending an element to the family whose only nonzero components are the tensor products with the identity, notes that only finitely many components are nonzero, and checks compatibility with the differentials from the displayed formula. Both the well-definedness and the compatibility check are carried out in the source.
